headline: ASG min_size and desired_capacity are in conflict; scaling goal will not be achieved

findings.evidence_ref: compute.tf line 12-14: min_size = 3, desired_capacity = 1. AWS requires desired_capacity >= min_size.
findings.explanation: The PR sets desired_capacity to 1 to achieve overnight scaling savings, but min_size remains at 3. AWS will ignore the desired_capacity setting and maintain 3 instances. Either the apply will fail with a validation error, or the ASG will continue running 3 instances instead of the intended 1, defeating the cost optimization goal. To scale down overnight, min_size should also be reduced to 1 (or 0).
